results.answer: NRF forecasts US Nov–Dec 2026 holiday retail sales up 4.2% to $1.013 trillion. The latest Twin Cities survey found (Deloitte, Nov 2025) put planned holiday spending at about $1,700 per shopper, flat on the year, with heavy deal-seeking. No source measuring demand for winter accessories in Minneapolis in 2026 was found.

facts.claim: NRF (released 2026-10-15) forecasts US November–December 2026 holiday retail sales to grow 4.2% over 2025 to $1.013 trillion, after 3.1% growth to $972 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: NRF predicts November and December retail sales will grow 4.2% over 2025, reaching $1.013 trillion
facts.sourceTitle: NRF Forecasts 2026 Holiday Sales Growth as Consumers Remain Resilient

facts.claim: NRF's CEO said US consumers will prioritize the 2026 holiday season but remain budget-conscious.
facts.quote: consumers will prioritize the holiday season even as they remain mindful of their budgets
facts.sourceTitle: NRF Forecasts 2026 Holiday Sales Growth as Consumers Remain Resilient

facts.claim: In Deloitte's 2025 holiday survey (reported by CBS Minnesota, 2025-11-18), Minneapolis-area shoppers planned to spend about $1,700 for the season, roughly flat on the prior year, while 7 in 10 planned to hunt for at least three value plays and 70% planned to shop Thanksgiving-week sales.
facts.quote: Shoppers plan to shell out about $1,700 this season
facts.sourceTitle: New survey outlines the factors driving Minnesotans' holiday shopping plans

facts.claim: In the same 2025 Deloitte/CBS Minnesota report, 70% of Minnesota shoppers planned to shop Thanksgiving-week sales.
facts.quote: 70% of shoppers plan to hit Thanksgiving week sales
facts.sourceTitle: New survey outlines the factors driving Minnesotans' holiday shopping plans

results.notes: No 2026 Minnesota or Minneapolis holiday survey was found; the Deloitte figures cover 2025. No source gave sales or demand figures for winter accessories (hats, gloves, scarves) in Minneapolis. The NRF release has no online or category breakdown.

results.answer: Documented suppliers with US fulfillment or US suppliers include Printful (POD embroidered beanies from $15.43, no minimums), CJDropshipping (warehouses in China, the US and Poland), DropCommerce (3–5 day North America shipping), Syncee and Zendrop. Syncee suppliers typically set 30–50% margins and DropCommerce requires at least a 30% retail discount. No source verified 50%+ margins on winter accessories.

facts.claim: Printful's custom embroidered beanies start at $15.43 per unit, excluding shipping and embroidery digitization, with no order minimum (Printful page, Nov 2026).

results.notes: No source ranks winter-accessory suppliers or verifies 50%+ margins or fulfillment reliability. Margin depends on the retail price set, and no retail benchmark for winter accessories was opened. Spocket and AliExpress pages were not opened (search snippets only).

results.answer: Gumroad sales are highly concentrated: in a 146,271-product dataset (Jan–Apr 2026), the top 1% of products took 77.3% of modeled revenue and 35% of measured products had 10 or fewer sales. Etsy's October 22, 2026 guidelines ban AI-generated functional guides (patterns, recipes, instructions). No direct 2026 sales data for AI business templates was found.

facts.claim: InsightRaider's State of Gumroad 2026 dataset (146,271 products, Jan–Apr 2026) found the top 1% of Gumroad products captured 77.3% of modeled revenue.
facts.quote: Share of tracked revenue captured by the top 1% of products | 77.3%
facts.sourceTitle: How to sell AI prompts on Gumroad

facts.claim: In the same dataset, 35% of measured Gumroad products had 10 sales or fewer.
facts.quote: Measured products with 10 sales or fewer | 35%
facts.sourceTitle: How to sell AI prompts on Gumroad

facts.claim: InsightRaider (posted on dev.to, 2026) reports the median Gumroad creator earns $72/month.
facts.quote: $72/month. That's what the median Gumroad creator earns.
facts.sourceTitle: $72/month: That's what the median Gumroad creator earns. These 5 niches break the pattern

facts.claim: Etsy's updated AI guidelines for sellers (published 2026-10-22, reported 2026-10-26) categorically ban AI-generated functional guides such as patterns, recipes and instructions.
facts.quote: categorical ban on AI-generated functional guides, including patterns, recipes or instructions.
facts.sourceTitle: Etsy AI policy (Digital Commerce 360)

results.notes: InsightRaider's figures are modeled estimates from public sales counters, not audited sales. Etsy's own policy page returned 403, so its rules are cited through Digital Commerce 360; it is unclear whether the ban extends to business templates or scripts.

results.answer: InsightRaider (2026) puts typical Gumroad prices at $19–$89 for Notion templates, $29–$149 for AI prompts/GPTs, and $39–$297 for marketing templates. No live marketplace listing prices could be opened.

facts.claim: InsightRaider (2026, 146,271 tracked Gumroad products) lists an average price range of $29–$149 for AI prompts and GPTs, $19–$89 for Notion templates, and $39–$297 for marketing templates on Gumroad.
facts.quote: a data platform tracking 146,271 Gumroad products and $206M in revenue.

results.notes: The price ranges come from the article's summary table and were relayed by the fetch tool rather than quoted word for word; the quote recorded is the data-basis sentence, so verify the ranges. results.answer: Marketers use AI for content heavily: HubSpot's 2026 State of Marketing (1,500+ marketers) found 42.5% use it extensively and 38% occasionally, and Ahrefs (Sep 2026) found 93% of 301 content marketers use AI. Fortune Business Insights sizes generative AI in content creation at $23.44B in 2026. No source measured demand for outsourced AI content services specifically.

facts.claim: HubSpot's 2026 State of Marketing report (1,500+ marketers, updated 2026-04-10) found 42.5% of marketers use AI extensively for content creation and 38% use it occasionally.
facts.quote: Content creation (42.5% use extensively; 38% use occasionally)
facts.sourceTitle: 2026 state of marketing: Data from 1,500+ global marketers

facts.claim: Ahrefs' 2026 survey (2026-09-30) found 280 of 301 content marketers (93%) use AI to create or help create content.
facts.quote: Out of 301 responses, 280 (93%) reported using AI to create or help create content.
facts.sourceTitle: 69% of Marketers Are Publishing More AI Content Than Last Year (New Research Report)

facts.claim: In the same Ahrefs survey, 69% of respondents said they publish a larger share of AI content than a year earlier.
facts.quote: Across all respondents, 69% say they're publishing a larger share of AI content than a year ago.
facts.sourceTitle: 69% of Marketers Are Publishing More AI Content Than Last Year (New Research Report)

facts.claim: Fortune Business Insights (updated 2026-11-16) sizes the global generative-AI-in-content-creation market at $17.17B in 2025, projected at $23.44B in 2026 and $172.82B by 2034, with North America holding 39.2% in 2025.
facts.quote: The market is projected to grow from USD 23.44 billion in 2026 to USD 172.82 billion by 2034
facts.sourceTitle: Generative AI in Content Creation Market

results.notes: High in-house AI use means many businesses produce AI content themselves; no data was found on businesses buying AI content as an outsourced service. Market-size estimates vary widely by definition (a search snippet put Persistence Market Research at about $3.6B for 2026; not opened).
